discovery: Experimental discovery of the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (fractional Chern insulators at zero magnetic field) in moire materials

nominees.name: Kin Fai Mak
nominees.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter, Hamburg, Germany / Cornell University, USA

subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological phases and quantum Hall effects
motivation: For decades the fractional quantum Hall effect was believed to require Landau levels in a strong magnetic field. Theory suggested that interacting electrons in a flat Chern band could form fractionalized topological liquids without any external field, but realizing this seemed remote. In 2023-2024 Xiaodong Xu (optical and transport studies of twisted MoTe2), Kin Fai Mak (with Jie Shan, independent thermodynamic and transport evidence in twisted MoTe2) and Long Ju (rhombohedral pentalayer graphene on hBN) observed quantized fractional Hall resistance at zero magnetic field, driven by spontaneous time-reversal breaking in lattice Chern bands. These experiments establish a new state of matter: fractional Chern insulators with anyonic excitations, emerging from band topology and interactions alone. They open a clean, tunable route to non-Abelian phases and topological quantum computation, and show again that quantum mechanics is richer than we dreamed.
